name: Cross Mod
description: OP0 and OP1 modulate each other's phase for a classic cross-modulation timbre. True same-sample cross-modulation would form a zero-delay cycle, which the compiler rejects (see docs/ALGORITHM_GRAPH.md) -- so one direction (OP1 -> OP0) is feed-forward PM and the other (OP0 -> OP1) is a one-sample-delayed FEEDBACK-type edge. Both carriers reach output.
